title: Many letters, by month
note: Chapters by month of age, newest first, each opened by a kicker, a large numeral, "2 letters · From Mama" and the month's dates, with a hairline between chapters. The current month is lit and stands alone until a letter is kept in it. Each card shows the first words ending in a fade, the signature and a recording length; a private letter carries a "Private" mark. (Seeded fictional family Asha.) Full length capture shows every chapter.

lines: Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw.
You rolled over all by yourself, twice, and then looked at me like you had always known how.
So it rained all morning so we sat by the window and you tried to catch the drops on the glass. You were so serious about it.
You smell like warm milk and the lavender soap Papa insists on. I could sit here all night.
You laughed today. A real one. It sounded like a little hiccup that surprised you as much as it surprised me.
Asha, you are four days old and the whole house is quiet. Your Nani made dal and nobody ate it because we were all watching you sleep.
